svg.title: Mechanical whisk — articulated vector animation
svg.desc: Pure SVG geometry reconstructed from the Blender scene: fixed grip and housing; crank gear, rim, four pins, stem and knob; oppositely driven pinion, shaft and five NURBS-derived wire loops. The original 8-second motion is repeated: ready, 1.5 clockwise crank turns, pause, 1.5 counterclockwise turns, rest. Directions are viewed from the knob. Native SVG SMIL; no scripts, images, textures, or external resources.
